notes.title: Terminal Singularity's Unit Customization DLC is on sale!
notes.notes: We are having a sale! Only this week - get Terminal Singularity's Unit Customization DLC for 25% less! Escape the singularity in style!

notes.title: Terminal Singularity is now available!
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce that our first game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1217510/Terminal_Singularity/]Terminal Singularity[/url], has been officially released and is now available to the Steam community! You can play it for free on Windows and Linux machines.

Alongside the main game, we have also released the optional [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1271350/Terminal_Singularity__Unit_Customization/]Unit Customization DLC[/url], which offers unparalleled possibilities for cosmetic changes to your units.

If you like our game, please spread the word! Thank you for giving us a chance!
